motive.zhHans: Hakuya 买衣服当作送给 Hikaru 的礼物，是想弄清她的身材尺寸，好确定那条隧道该挖多宽。他预见自己会和 Mina 重新在一起，于是执行了计划，试图借此弄到钱。动机是为 Youko 复仇——Youko 那场「意外」死亡其实是 Jouhei、Shimizu、Kamiyo 和 Asanobu 合谋策划的。由于 Hakuya 是医生，他一定是给 Shimizu 下了某种药稀释她的血液，再用导管从她颈动脉把血抽出来。
motive.en: Hakuya bought clothes as gifts to Hikaru because he wants to find out her body size to see how wide to make the tunnel. Foreseeing that he'd get back together with Mina and he did the plan and try to get the money that way. The motive was avenge Youko whose "accidental" death was actually plotted by Jouhei, Shimizu, Kamiyo and Asanobu. Since Hakuya was a doctor he must have drugged Shimizu with something to thin out her blood and drew it out from artery at her neck with a catheter.

resolution.zhHans: 凶手是 Jouhei Hagawa。Hikaru Hinohara 其实是 Hakuya 的女儿，依据是发现于他房间里的遗嘱和 DNA 报告。他用来逃脱的那条隧道是为 Hikaru 挖的。Hakuya 买衣服当作送给 Hikaru 的礼物，是想弄清她的身材尺寸，好确定那条隧道该挖多宽。他本想让 Hikaru 去执行他为她拟定的连环杀人计划。不过他也给了她不实施谋杀的选择。所有机关的做法是：他本要在早上、当她待在那间国外拷问室时告诉她，但 Jouhei 在她手机上拦截了那条讯息。他预见自己会和 Mina 重新在一起，于是执行了计划，试图借此弄到钱。Hakuya 为了让这些机关成立而枭首自杀。随计划一起的还有他的手机、冷冻室的钥匙，以及炸毁隧道的开关。动机是为 Youko 复仇——Youko 那场「意外」死亡其实是 Jouhei、Shimizu、Kamiyo 和 Asanobu 合谋策划的。由于 Hakuya 是医生，他一定是给 Shimizu 下了某种药稀释她的血液，再用导管从她颈动脉把血抽出来。Jouhei 悄悄潜到棺材下方的藏匿处，通过一条密道取走了那颗头颅。
resolution.en: The culprit is Jouhei Hagawa. Hikaru Hinohara was actually Hakuya's daughter due to the will and DNA report found in his room. The tunnel that he was escaping in was made for Hikaru. Hakuya bought clothes as gifts to Hikaru because he wants to find out her body size to see how wide to make the tunnel. He wanted Hikaru to do the serial murder plan that he made for her. However he also gave her the option of not committing the murders. All the tricks done was he was to tell her when she was at the foreign torture in the morning but Jouhei intercepted the message on her phone. Foreseeing that he'd get back together with Mina and he did the plan and try to get the money that way. Hakuya committed suicide by decapitation to make the tricks work. Along with the plan there is his cellphone, the keys the freezer and the switch to blow up the tunnel. The motive was avenge Youko whose "accidental" death was actually plotted by Jouhei, Shimizu, Kamiyo and Asanobu. Since Hakuya was a doctor he must have drugged Shimizu with something to thin out her blood and drew it out from artery at her neck with a catheter. Jouhei snuck over to he hiding space underneath the coffin and retreived the head using a secret passage.
